description: SYNTHORA cve-intel: Vulnerability intelligence that does not depend on NVD: one call merges OSV (GHSA, PyPA, RustSec, Go, MAL), CISA KEV (exploited in the wild, ransomware use, federal due date), FIRST EPSS (30-day exploitation probability) and the ENISA EUVD, with fixed versions, a P0-P3 patch priority, a plain-language plan by our own model (marked as AI) and a self-resolving calibration question (will it enter KEV in 30 days?). Accepts CVE, GHSA, PYSEC, RUSTSEC, GO and MAL ids. Ed25519-signed, no charge on failure or unknown id, no free tier. [x402: 0.005 USDC per call on Base]

id.description: CVE, GHSA, PYSEC, RUSTSEC, GO or MAL id
